faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Crop Protector post?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Crop Protector post is 03-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the office before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Crop Protector role?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years for the Crop Protector position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Crop Protector post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Crop Protector post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 11851.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Crop Protector post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation and completed a mandatory 5-day training from the Agriculture and Horticulture Directorate, along with knowledge of the local language.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Crop Protector post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Crop Protector post announced by Junior Plant Protection Office Hazaribagh.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Crop Protector recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Merit List compiled from General Hindi, Local Language, and Conduct Certificate scores.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Crop Protector position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. In which city and state is this job located?
faq.answer: The job is located in Hazaribagh, Jharkhand, with the pincode 825301.

faq.question: Q10. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply offline by downloading the application form, filling it correctly, attaching necessary documents, and sending it via post to the address mentioned in the official notification before the last date.
